critical_code_review_comments: payment_processing_router.verify: allows editing an existing verified row while stage=='verified' (only in_bank_file/paid are blocked) — good, matches spec. However, if the row was previously 'rejected', the branch stage=p.decision will simply overwrite to verified/rejected freely; consider audit trail retention if a rejected row can silently be re-verified.

mark_paid: writes JE with net computed locally as amt-tds-advance but the 'net' leg (CR 1100) is skipped when net<=0. If verified_amount==tds+advance (100% adjusted), JE will have only DR + CR 2400 + CR 1510 which is balanced and correct. Good.

bank-file endpoint uses net_payable if present else falls back to verified_amount — fine for legacy verifications lacking net_payable, but exposes a potential mismatch if TDS/advance were captured but net_payable wasn't recomputed on legacy rows. Not observed in current data.
PaymentProcessingCenter.jsx (541 lines) is large; consider splitting VerifyDialog/MarkPaidDialog/BankFilesTable into sub-components for maintainability (soft nit).
